unsupported: Nick's Wood Shop LLC was founded in 2015 in Wakefield, Nebraska, by Nick Sebade.
The business primarily serves residential construction and kitchen-and-bath remodeling projects, working with homeowners and builders on new builds and renovations.
Clients engage the shop for complete kitchen cabinetry, bathroom vanities, and standalone furniture items, with the company sourcing hardware and countertop materials to simplify procurement.
Free on-site estimates within the service area further reduce friction for prospective clients.
